name: scroll-images-reveal-003
tagline: Full-height photo cards pile up as you scroll, then shrink and spin away.
summary: A scrolling stack of sticky, nearly full-height image cards. Each card pins near the top, and as you scroll past it rotates, shrinks and fades out while the next one takes over.
appearance: A column of wide rounded rectangles, each almost a full screen tall and filled edge to edge with a photo cropped to cover. They sit down the page with large gaps, and a small uppercase hint for scrolling sits near the top.
behaviour: Each card sticks below the top edge once it reaches it. Scrolling further rotates and scales it toward nothing while the photo inside counter-rotates, and the following card comes up underneath.
demo_content: Seven Unsplash landscape photos and the hint 'scroll down to see effect'.
search_phrases: sticky image cards that stack on scroll
photos that shrink and rotate away
use_when: A long visual story or portfolio needs full-height photos that hold attention as the page scrolls.
avoid_when: Each card is about 80vh tall and the stack runs for many screens, so it is unsuited to short pages.
customise: Only the images array is a prop; card height, scroll distance, margin and the spin and shrink mapping are constants in the file.
weight_why: Seven sticky cards track scroll with motion values under a smooth-scroll wrapper.

a11y.note: There is no reduced-motion handling, and each image's alt text is its raw URL, so photos have no useful description.

issues: No reduced-motion path: the shrink-and-spin scroll effect runs regardless of the user preference.
Image alt text is the raw URL, which tells screen reader users nothing about the photo.
polish_why: No frames to judge; the code is a tidy, conventional sticky-stack effect.
